AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This app manages the user's favorite jokes.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'getFavorites' to inspect the current favorites and obtain their joke IDs. - Use 'setFavorite' when the ID of the target joke is known. - Use 'clearFavorites' only when the user wants to remove all favorites.
Constraints: - Clearing all favorites must only be performed when explicitly requested by the user.
